item.title: Eiichiro Oda’s ‘ONE PIECE’ Vol. 115 Rises to No. 1 on Japan Book Hot 100
item.description:
[Intro music plays]
Host: Welcome to this week's trending on Billboard Japan Book Hot 100. We've got some exciting updates for you, so let's dive right in.
[Soft music continues in the background]
Host: Climbing to the top spot is Eiichiro Oda's ONE PIECE Vol. 115, which jumped from number 2 to number 1 on the chart released July 16th. This title is dominating brick-and-mortar sales and is also performing well in e-commerce and social media. The digital edition is set to drop on August 4th.
Host: Last week's number one debut, Yoshihiro Togashi's HUNTER×HUNTER Vol. 39, is now at number 2, just barely behind ONE PIECE. It's still leading in e-book sales and holding strong in brick-and-mortar and e-commerce.
Host: We've also got some new entries on the chart. Takashi's debut photobook, BULLET TRAIN TAKASHI 1st Photobook "xemx," has burst onto the scene at number 3, thanks to its strong performance in e-commerce. Hiromu Arakawa's Yomi no Tsugai Vol. 13 has also launched at number 5, with a top 20 finish across all formats.
Host: And in other news, Ryunosuke Matsushita's Ichijigen no Sashiki has seen a significant jump from number 27 to number 13, following the live-action drama adaptation's premiere on July 5th.
[Outro music starts playing]
Host: That's all for this week's Billboard Japan Book Hot 100 update. If you want to check out the full top 10 list, you can find it on our website. Thanks for tuning in, and we'll see you next time.
[Outro music continues to play until the end]
